page.content:
Structured-data sister project that feeds infoboxes and interlanguage links.

How Wikidata connects

  • Faction: Wikimedia Foundation — Wikidata is a Wikimedia Foundation sister project.
  • Item: Interlanguage links — Wikidata now stores the sitelinks that connect language editions.

What is Wikidata?

Wikidata stores items and statements that language editions query, turning the encyclopedia's hidden graph into an explicit one.

Key threads lead to Wikimedia Foundation and Interlanguage links.
